summary: Frontend-only regression + 4 new-feature verification for the Sideline event creation wizard. All 4 new features PASS: (1) Native-style calendar + 3-wheel time picker render on the 'When' step (cal-prev/cal-next/cal-day-<n>/wheel-hour/wheel-minute/wheel-period all present, live 'date · time' summary updates). (2) Draft autosave via storage key 'sideline.draft.event' works — closing the wizard mid-flow and reopening shows draft-banner + title-input prefilled 'My Draft Event'; start-over-btn clears form + banner. (3) Duplicate Event opens the wizard titled 'Duplicate Event' with title suffixed ' (copy)' and Review carries paid mode + $25 price + $4.99 fee from source e5. (4) Photo upload tile 'upload-cover-btn' renders alongside preset cover tiles cover-0..N; tapping it triggers the web file chooser without crash. Regressions clean: full happy path (Basics → When → Where → Participation → Extras → Review → Publish → 'Event published!' → View in Schedule) works; paid path inserts Payment step (price-input, method-paypal/venmo) and Review shows the $4.99 platform fee before publish. Zero JS console/red-box errors observed across all flows.
critical_code_review_comments: create-event.tsx: hydrate() sets `methods.venmo = (paid.methods ?? []).includes('venmo') || true` — the `|| true` makes it always true, defeating the source event's method list on duplicate. Same bug for paypal. Not blocking (both default to true anyway) but should be `.includes('venmo')` only.

create-event.tsx line 62: type Mode uses `params.mode === 'paid'` for defaulting to paid, but the route push from event/[id].tsx uses `?duplicate=...` (no mode param) — this is correct, just noting the two code paths are independent.
datetime.tsx Wheel: `pointerEvents='none'` on View is deprecated in RN web; expected to log a deprecation warning (ignored per request).
seed_data_creation: None. Used in-memory store seed (e5, e6). Draft-autosave localStorage entry was written & then start-over cleared it.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 review-request scenarios verified on phone viewport 390x844 at https://team-pulse-205.preview.emergentagent.com. Draft persists across wizard close/reopen within the same browser session via localStorage key 'sideline.draft.event'. When testing schedule-card-e5, use `.first` selector — the testID appears twice in the RN-web DOM (outer Pressable + inner content share the id via wrapper) but there's only one visible card; `.click(force=True)` on `.first` navigates correctly to /event/e5. File chooser triggered by upload-cover-btn on web is expected; cannot select a real file — just Escape it.
